title: console: an object route whose app package holds none of its objects (and every record route) reads the whole object registry before the first paint (751,603 bytes, 110 objects on cloud's 环境)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from objectstack-ai/cloud#2914 round 6 (dev report `6266910210`). ⛔ Not a claim: the objectui lane dispatches it.

**How it was measured:**
- The rig ran cloud `eca60c38` (framework `fb9c22aa`, objectui `47508f3b`) on `run-stack --prod-like --with-ui --seed`.
- The subject was an ordinary organization owner. Each page got one warm-up, then 8 full warm opens, counted from the page's performance entries.
- Producers were found from CDP initiator stacks, mapped through a hidden-sourcemap build that is byte-identical to the served console.
- The maintainer's staging reading `6265264751` shows the same duplicate paths.

## What was measured (8/8 opens)

`GET /api/v1/meta/object`, the whole registry (751,603 bytes, 110 objects), is read before the first paint on two cloud control-plane pages:

- **The 环境 list** (the sidebar's second item; the read spans 921–1030 ms of a 1290 ms splash on the rig).
  - `console/appObjectScope.ts:292` first asks `meta/object?package=com.objectstack.cloud` (via `console/ConsoleShell.tsx:101` and `providers/MetadataProvider.tsx:950`). That answers 0 objects in 28 bytes, on every page.
  - So `appObjectScope.ts:294` falls back to the whole registry: `providers/MetadataProvider.tsx:802`, read by `console/AppContent.tsx:420`.
  - It falls back because the `cloud_control` app's package (cloud `packages/app-cloud/src/index.ts:17`) holds none of the objects it shows. `sys_environment` is in `com.objectstack.service-tenant`; `sys_member`, `sys_organization` and `sys_invitation` are in `com.objectstack.plugin-auth`. That is cloud's one-app-package pattern, not an authoring error.
- **An environment's record page.** A record route reads the whole registry by design (`appObjectScope.ts`'s header: related lists from every object that points at the record's object).

objectstack-ai/cloud#2914's Target 3 asks that the whole-registry call is not on the open path. It holds on cloud's page routes (pricing, home, 成员), which scope through `pageObjectNames`. The card's first staging reading had this call at 5.7 s.

## Target

When an app's package holds none of its objects, scope an object route by name: the route's object, its lookup targets and `requiresObject` entries. On a record route whose record page is declared, read the objects that page binds, the way page routes already do.

objectui chose the whole registry for Setup's shape on purpose (by-name reads measured costlier on HotCRM), so the rule needs a measured criterion. ⛔ Do not regress Setup.

## Acceptance

- A full open of cloud's 环境 list and of an environment record reads no `meta/object` without a name before the first paint.
- Setup's and HotCRM's opens are measured before and after, with no regression.
- Tests for the scope rule, with an ablation.
